message:
As winter storms start to swirl outside, I find myself retreating to my favorite reading nook, tucked away like a cozy burrito. The kids, of course, think I’m plotting some sort of secret escape—little do they know I’m just trying to savor a moment of quiet before they inevitably burst in like a snowball fight gone rogue. 

I always keep a blanket and a good book handy, just in case the power decides to play hide-and-seek. How do you carve out a little calm during the chaos? 🧣
scene: a snug reading nook by a frosted winter window (just after cleanup, everything tidy)
